sources.title: Arko007/Zenyx-V3-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Zenyx V3 is a highly efficient 1.5B parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) foundation model designed for low-latency inference, high throughput, and context length extensibility. Current Training Status: Zenyx V3 is currently under active pretraining on a diverse corpus of web text, mathematics, and programming code.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers.
